_rule: Link-out only (G8): nothing here is re-hosted. Descriptions are original. lastVerified is an ISO date only when the official source was checked online that day; otherwise "unverified" and a person must confirm it on the official site before release (G9/G10). Adult-only scope (G12). Emergency numbers live in content/crisis-lines.json.

entries.name: Find A Helpline
entries.description: Global directory of free, confidential crisis lines and helplines, filterable by country and topic. Use it for any country not listed here.
entries.verification: Directory pages surfaced in web search on 2026-11-26 (findahelpline.com/organizations/...); site not reachable from the build sandbox.

entries.name: WHO Mental Health Gap Action Programme (mhGAP)
entries.description: WHO guidance for scaling up care for mental, neurological and substance use conditions, including the mhGAP Intervention Guide for non-specialist settings. A clinician reference, not a referral service.
entries.verification: Official WHO page fetched directly on 2026-11-26 (title 'Mental Health, Brain Health and Substance Use'; mhGAP section present).

entries.name: NHS 111, mental health option (England)
entries.description: Urgent mental health help in England: call 111 and choose the mental health option to speak with a trained mental health professional, for yourself or someone else, at any age.
notes: Immediate risk to life: call 999 or go to A&E.
Deaf callers can use SignVideo or Relay UK (18001 111).
entries.verification: Option 2, 24/7 availability and relay options cross-checked by web search against NHS England and NHS trust pages (national rollout 2024). The nhs.uk page was not reachable from the build sandbox.

sources.title: NHS 111 offering crisis mental health support for the first time

entries.name: Samaritans (UK)
entries.description: Free, confidential listening support by phone for anyone who is struggling to cope, at any time of day or night.
entries.verification: 116 123 cited by Mind's helplines page in web search results; samaritans.org not reachable from the build sandbox.

entries.name: Shout 85258 (UK)
entries.description: Free, confidential text support with a trained volunteer for anyone in the UK who is struggling to cope.
entries.verification: Keyword and short code cross-checked by web search (NHS trust pages); giveusashout.org not reachable from the build sandbox.

entries.name: Mind Infoline (England and Wales)
entries.description: Information line from the mental health charity Mind about conditions, treatment options, rights and local support. Not a crisis service.

entries.name: Samaritans Ireland
entries.description: Free, confidential listening support by phone for anyone in Ireland who is finding things hard, at any time.
entries.verification: Freephone 116 123 cross-checked by web search against HSE urgent-help pages; samaritans.org not reachable from the build sandbox.

entries.name: 50808 (Ireland)
entries.description: Free, anonymous text conversation with a trained volunteer for anyone in Ireland going through a mental health or emotional crisis.
entries.verification: Keyword HELLO and number cross-checked by web search against HSE urgent-help pages; text50808.ie not reachable from the build sandbox.

entries.name: 9-8-8: Suicide Crisis Helpline (Canada)
entries.description: Canada's national suicide crisis helpline, by call or text, in English and French, for anyone thinking about suicide or worried about someone.
notes: Responders can connect to support in Cree, Ojibway and Inuktitut on request via the Hope for Wellness Helpline.
entries.verification: Call/text 9-8-8 (launched November 30, 2023) cross-checked by web search against Government of Canada and CRTC pages; 988.ca not reachable from the build sandbox.

sources.title: Government of Canada launches three-digit suicide crisis helpline

entries.name: Hope for Wellness Helpline (Canada)
entries.description: Immediate counseling and crisis support for First Nations, Inuit and Métis people across Canada, by phone or online chat, with service in Cree, Ojibway and Inuktitut on request.
entries.verification: Number and chat cross-checked by web search (Wellness Together Canada transition FAQ and Health Canada notice); hopeforwellness.ca not reachable from the build sandbox.

sources.title: Health Canada announces transition of mental health resources from Wellness Together Canada

entries.name: Government of Canada mental health supports (replaces Wellness Together Canada)
entries.description: Federal page listing current mental health and substance use supports in Canada. Wellness Together Canada closed on April 3, 2024, and Health Canada now points people here.
notes: Wellness Together Canada is no longer operating; do not refer clients to it.
entries.verification: Closure date and the canada.ca/mental-health pointer cross-checked by web search against Health Canada's February 2024 notice and the Wellness Together FAQ; canada.ca not reachable from the build sandbox.

entries.name: Medicare Mental Health (formerly Head to Health), Australia
entries.description: Free national phone service and website that assesses what kind of mental health support a person needs and connects them to local services. Not a crisis service.
notes: The Head to Health phone service and website were renamed Medicare Mental Health in 2025; the number did not change.
entries.verification: Rename, number and hours cross-checked by web search against Primary Health Network notices and the medicarementalhealth.gov.au news item; site not reachable from the build sandbox.
